lines: 「Now that we've made it this far, we can relax...... right?」
Mari looked around the dim street, almost timidly.
Once we proceeded further down this road, there would be the entrance to the underground tunnel that exited Tokyo Kingdom.
It had taken some time because we had chosen deserted back streets, but we had finally managed to get all the way here.
「Y-Yeah...... Looks like there's no one chasing us from behind, for now.」
Una whispered, perking up her rabbit ears.
Rabbit Taimanin Mochizuki Una possessed superhuman hearing ability.
It was thanks to her outstanding vigilance that we had gotten this far without running into almost any enemies.
「All right. Looks like we're almost there.」
「Indeed we are...... But we can't relax our guard until the very end.」
「They do say, “It's still an exam mission until you get back home.”」
「You don't know? I take it that adage has been secretly going around the Academy.」
「This “exam mission” is being conducted under different circumstances than usual, after all. It seems we're encountering a lot of unforeseen difficulties.」
「It basically means, “Keep focused right until the end,” you see.」
「Yeah. Now that you mention it, I have heard that......」
This “exam mission” was to be carried out by an improvised team that was different from the usual.
In real conditions, the difficulty level of a mission grew higher when there were members you weren't familiar with.

Fortunately, in my case, the team members for the mission were people I knew (namely Mari and Mai), and our target was a small-time organization, so we had been able to clear it without much hardship.
But for other teams that were, like us, taking their “exam missions” right now, Taimanin teachers were accompanying them in supervisory/backup roles, just in case.
That was to say, these “exam missions” were that difficult and unforgiving.
（Well, even we ourselves have gotten caught up in something like this.）
The mission should have been done with, yet we were running around the criminal city like this.
It was the epitome of the students' motto, “until you get back home.”
All of a sudden, the werewolf stopped in his tracks.
While knitting his eyebrows suspiciously, he was sniffing the surrounding scents.
「Some kind of odd smell mixed into the air just now. It might be my imagination, but there's something nearby――」
「――It's here it's here it's here!! Fuuma-kun, everyone, it's right nearby!!」
「Right near us, the sound of a really strong heartbeat――!!!」
Una perked up her ears and cried out.
A gigantic dark shadow suddenly leaped out.
Its sharp claws were swung downward at Mari and Mai, who were standing right in front of it.
Sparks flew in the darkness, making a tremendous metallic clang.
We were fully expecting there would be a surprise attack.
Thanks to Mari's Earth Escape Arts and Mai's Paper Spirit Arts, the assailant's vicious claws were blocked.
A tremendous shock, like the core of my body had been punched directly――
As soon as I received that, my field of vision suddenly went black.
My whole body stiffened, along with a suffocating feeling like someone had grabbed hold of my heart.
That was one of the abilities beastmen had.
Appealing to the target's biological instincts with a powerful roar, to bind their mind and body――
It was probably because they had been blasted by the roar at point-blank range.
Mari and Mai were completely stunned, and fell to their knees on the ground.
Looking down at the two of them, the gigantic beast was roaring.
Golden fur covering its entire body.
A huge build clad in prominent muscle. Sharp fangs. Both eyes crazed and bloodshot.
It was one of the kinds of demonic beast that lurked in this dark city.
It seemed that, to fool the werewolf's nose, it had been waiting for us, hidden by a sheet covered with tar or something.
The weretiger's claws swung down once again at the immobilized Mari and Mai. And then――
「Y-You moron!! Get a hold of yourself―― GAAAAAUUUUU!!!」
It was the werewolf, the weretiger's Kyoudai.
He staggered to his feet, took beastman form, and blocked his brother's claws and fangs head-on as they flew at Mari and Mai.
Sharp fangs sank deep into the top of the werewolf's shoulder.
The weretiger didn't respond, even to its brother's appeal.
It ruthlessly tore apart the werewolf's body with its sharp fangs and claws.
「F-Fuuma-kun, what do we do about this?!!」
Perhaps because Una had also avoided a direct hit from the roar, she seemed like she was just about able to move.
In any case, for now, we had to get the stunned Mari and Mai away from the weretiger――
I raised my face, and gasped.
「Kuku, you've caused us some trouble, haven't you......? I'll have you return that case.」
As if seeping out from the darkness, incubi emerged.
